en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a group of African street vendors outdoors under large trees. Several adults in patterned cloth garments display and sell textiles laid out on the ground; one woman has a baby tied to her back. A man in a light-colored suit holds up a cloth, as others handle or fold fabrics. The scene appears candid and ethnographic. At the bottom of the image, a caption in Portuguese reads "Loanda Vendedores Ambulantes."
